reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), churned AS (
  -- one row per month with churn events
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS churns
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, COALESCE(c.churns, 0) AS churns
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN churned c ON c.month = m.month

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
)

FROM months m

GROUP BY m.month

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS month FROM generate_series(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) t(d)
), c AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS churns
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.month, COALESCE(c.churns, 0) AS churns
FROM months m LEFT JOIN c ON c.month = m.month
